summary: Frontend-only regression for LOKAGER Module 1 final features: Compare (toggle, tray, max 3, compare page + table, persist across SPA nav, clear/remove) and Share Shortlist / Shared ?ids view (invalid-ID resilience, save-all merge, header count sync, localStorage persistence). All acceptance criteria pass with zero horizontal overflow across 1920/1440/1366/430/390 and zero console errors. Locked areas (home hero, header, /launch) unaffected.
verified_flows: COMPARE TOGGLE: property-card-<id>-compare toggles data-active true/false; tray appears at 1+.
COMPARE MAX 3: 4th add is rejected (thumbnails stay at 3) and toast 'You can compare up to 3 properties.' shown.
COMPARE TRAY: compare-remove-<id> works; compare-clear empties + hides tray; compare-open disabled at 1, enabled at 2.

COMPARE PAGE: /compare shows compare-page + compare-table with 8 rows (Price/Type/Bedrooms/Area/Locality/Listed by/Status/Freshness). compare-col-remove-<id> drops a column; compare-page-clear empties; <2 shows compare-empty + compare-browse.
COMPARE PERSISTS via SPA nav (/buy -> / -> /compare) — tray + selection retained. Full page reload resets store (documented/expected).
SHARE SHORTLIST: share-shortlist-button on /saved copies link (https://.../saved?ids=PB-201,PB-202) to clipboard and shows 'Shortlist link copied to clipboard.' toast.
SHARED VIEW: /saved?ids=PB-201,RN-301 shows 'Shared shortlist' header with save-all-button and only those 2 cards. Invalid IDs (e.g., BADID999) are silently filtered, no crash.
SAVE ALL merges shared into user shortlist (header count went 2 -> 3, no duplicates for PB-201).
SAVED REGRESSION: /saved lists user's saved cards, share + clear present, clear -> saved-empty, saved persists across full reload (localStorage).
LOCKED REGRESSION: Home renders (hero h1 present), header logo lockup unchanged, /launch idle ceremony intact, 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: useCompare uses module-level mutable state — intentional per spec but note it's not SSR-safe (fine for CRA client-only app).
SavedPage.shareShortlist: fallback path when clipboard.writeText rejects only shows generic toast; consider surfacing the raw URL for manual copy (minor UX).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Compare store is in-memory (module-scoped) and resets on hard page reload — expected. Use SPA link clicks (not page.goto) when validating cross-page persistence. Clipboard permissions are grantable via context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write']) on this preview host.
